name: styleverse-ecommerce
description: StyleVerse - Enterprise Clothing & Jewellery E-Commerce Platform

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
